title: Derivative of ψ(f)·l(|·|)·ζ in a direction orthogonal to the position vector
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let f, ζ : ℝ^P → ℝ and ψ, l : ℝ → ℝ, and let x, v ∈ ℝ^P with x ≠ 0 and ⟨x,v⟩ = 0. Assume f and ζ are differentiable at x, ψ is differentiable at f(x), and l is differentiable at |x|. Then h(y) := ψ(f(y))·l(|y|)·ζ(y) satisfies Dh(x)v = ψ(f(x))·l(|x|)·Dζ(x)v + ζ(x)·l(|x|)·(ψ'(f(x))·Df(x)v), where ψ' := deriv ψ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (f ζ : Euclid P → ℝ) (ψ l : ℝ → ℝ) (x v : Euclid P), x ≠ 0 → inner ℝ x v = 0 → DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ (f x) → DifferentiableAt ℝ l ‖x‖ → DifferentiableAt ℝ ζ x → fderiv ℝ (fun y : Euclid P => ψ (f y) * l ‖y‖ * ζ y) x v = ψ (f x) * l ‖x‖ * fderiv ℝ ζ x v + ζ x * l ‖x‖ * (deriv ψ (f x) * fderiv ℝ f x v)
